newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore sweetens foreign investment incentives.
newsitem.headline: Singapore sweetens foreign investment incentives.

text.p: Singapore on Thursday further sweetened tax incentives for foreign companies to expand investments in high value-added manufacturing or services sectors.

The development and expansion incentives, passed by parliament, provide for a concessionary tax rate of not less than 10 percent for a maximum 20-year period for companies planning to upgrade their investments.
The maximum period was 10 years under a previous scheme.
The new scheme also applies to companies which have not enjoyed pioneer status but could bring strong economic benefits to Singapore.
Other new incentives allow up to 100 percent of approved tax capital expenditure to be deducted against a company's taxable income, from the previous 50 percent.
